title: Monthly equity, index and cash-settled currency options expiration — February 2028 (the mirror of February 2027: the holiday falls the Monday AFTER, not inside the expiration week)
source: EST: RULE-DERIVED, and this entry says so rather than implying a published calendar reaches this date. The standing convention -- monthly equity, index and cash-settled currency options expire on the THIRD FRIDAY -- gives Friday 2028-02-18 (2028-02-01 is a Tuesday, computed from 2028-01-01 being a Saturday, so February's Fridays are the 4th, 11th, 18th and 25th). VALIDATED AGAINST THE OCC'S OWN CALENDAR USING THE ROW CLASS WHOSE TITLE IS THIS EVENT'S TITLE, WHICH IS THE IMPROVEMENT ON THE SOLE PRIOR PROPOSAL: optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes) and parsed by legend GUID rather than by eye. The proposal validated against the file's 'Monthly A.M. settled index options cease trading' rows -- a proxy class, third Friday minus one. This entry uses type 6937B1D1-F5D5-46CD-BBE7-041C7BE7B85B, 'Monthly equity, index, and cash-settled currency options expiration date and PM settled index options cease trading', 36 rows spanning 2025-01-17 -> 2027-12-17 and STOPPING THERE, 14 months short of this date. The third-Friday rule reproduces 33 of those 36 and all three misses are Friday-holiday displacements checked by name: Good Friday 2025-04-18, Juneteenth 2026-06-19, Juneteenth observed 2027-06-18. FEBRUARY IS EXACT 3-FOR-3 (2025-02-21, 2026-02-20, 2027-02-19), and February can carry no such displacement because its only US market holiday, Washington's Birthday, is always a Monday -- 2028-02-21, read this session off nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200 after 302, 109,180 bytes), whose 2028 column parses cell-by-cell as 'Washington's Birthday | Monday, February 21' with no other February closure and no early close. THE HONEST LIMIT THE PROPOSAL DID NOT STATE: all three Februaries in the OCC file are the OPPOSITE configuration to 2028 -- their holiday rows are 2025-02-17, 2026-02-16 and 2027-02-15, every one BEFORE the expiration -- so the fetched primary contains zero instances of this event's own shape. That gap is closed instead by 25 years of price data (14 February expirations with the holiday after, 2002-2024, none of them displaced off the third Friday). Filed estimate on the extrapolation past the OCC file's horizon and on this lane's standing no-self-confirm limit. Promotion requires an OCC or exchange primary published closer to the date, never a recomputation of the rule. Written by the opex-2028-02-18 initial research after reading the sole prior proposal, proposals/opex-2028-02-18.from-fomc-minutes-2028-02-16.json, which is now inert. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: READ IT, DO NOT TRADE IT. NOTHING TRADEABLE IS CLAIMED: symbols is empty, no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is opex-keyed -- re-grepped 2026-09-09 for `opex|expiration|witching|SOQ|third friday|LEAPS|pin`, whose four hits are all substring false positives on `pin` inside gapping/flipping/overlapping/dropping -- and the impact tier is inherited, not measured: medium matches every ordinary monthly opex-* entry, and 2028's quarterlies are March, June, September and December. THE STRUCTURAL FACT THAT SEPARATES THIS ENTRY FROM ITS FEBRUARY SIBLING: 2028's third Monday (2028-02-21) falls AFTER its third Friday, where 2027's (2027-02-15) fell before. So the expiration week is a full five sessions and the three-day weekend lands after expiry -- pre-window 2028-02-11 -> 02-18 spans a clean 7 calendar days, post-window 02-22, 02-23, 02-24, 02-25, 02-28 spans 10. That is opex-2027-01-15 leg 5's geometry in February, and this session measured the February half of it for the first time: over 25 years and two instruments the two estimators AGREE on this class (QQQ 8/14 raw and 8/14 gap-free, P = 0.791; SPY 8/14 and 7/14), median(raw / 1-day-returns) 1.018 QQQ and 1.002 SPY against January's 1.275 and 1.181. The sibling's estimator-disagreement warning is January's, not this geometry's. TWO RESULTS THIS LANE BANKS AGAINST ITSELF, both in the ledger. (1) The shelf's headline -- ordinary monthlies show a post-expiration unpin, quarterly witchings invert it -- does not survive out of its 2016-2026 window: at 296 expirations 2002-2026 the monthlies' gap-free rate is exactly 50.0% (QQQ 89/178, P = 1.000) and 47.8% (SPY), and no era x estimator cell of the monthly-versus-witching contrast clears Fisher P = 0.05. (2) A first-session-after weakness this session found in its own class (QQQ mean -0.723%, permutation P = 0.064) is Jan/Feb wearing a disguise -- indistinguishable from the holiday-BEFORE half of the same two months, and collapsing to P = 0.104 once 2008, 2009 and 2020 are dropped. NO NEW PROPOSAL WAS FILED: the +/-5-day corridor is already full (fomc-minutes-2028-02-16 canonical at D-2, and the proposals vix-expiration-2028-02-16 at D-2 and presidents-day-market-closure-2028-02-21 at D+3). The D-2 minutes adjacency is a null already banked by FT-opex-2027-11-19-2 and is cited rather than re-run. Estimate widens caution and licenses no entry.
